name: YouTube
description: SmartTube 1:1 Parity YouTube Integration for Jellyfin: Multi-User TV OAuth Login, Personal Home/Subscriptions/History/WatchLater Feeds, 4K Ad-Free Direct Streaming, SponsorBlock Auto-Skip, ReturnYouTubeDislike, Favorite-to-Like Sync, and Metadata & Artwork Providers.
overview: 1:1 SmartTube Android TV replacement for Jellyfin with per-user YouTube OAuth, SponsorBlock, ReturnYouTubeDislike, and 4K ad-free playback.

Full Changelog:

### ✨ New Features

- smarttube search integration, ai-search coordination & anti-clutter defaults ([6bf6283](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/6bf6283))
- yt-dlp auto-detection, anti-clutter channel tabs, configurable cache TTL & prefetch ([45ac9fc](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/45ac9fc))
- **trailers:** native movie & TV trailer support with anonymous guest playback ([2c08612](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/2c08612))
- **sync:** extract subscriptions via Innertube TV tabs and populate channel episodes ([1306e87](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/1306e87))
- **universal:** multi-user config, direct CDN streaming, rich descriptions, and collections sync ([563f148](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/563f148))
- **yt:** sponsorblock skip segments, native chapters, and auto-deployed HD library artwork ([016dbf4](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/016dbf4))
- **yt:** multi-resolution, subtitle filtering, publish date sync, rich description, YT tags/genres ([2c02936](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/2c02936))
- **playback,streams:** prune multi-audio HLS tracks, add YouTubePlaybackFilter, support full audio and subtitle parity ([74c4f59](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/74c4f59))
- **music:** add optional (default ON) YouTube Music library, channel, audio streaming, and universal settings ([943e99e](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/943e99e))
- YouTube music ([2f8b513](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/2f8b513))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **artwork:** replace legacy Crunchyroll template images with official YouTube assets and high-res thumb ([08a1cbf](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/08a1cbf))
- **services:** import YouTube.Filters namespace in PluginServiceRegistrator ([e8682d5](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/e8682d5))
- **playback:** resolve internal TLS handshake failure, add single-flight yt-dlp, and fix universal audio streams ([3c7f6a6](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/3c7f6a6))
- **playback:** honor X-Forwarded headers, handle AudioController endpoints, and verify playback ([1d2815a](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/1d2815a))
- **playback:** resolve public server url in streams, filter yt music liked songs and populate recommendations ([ddf6190](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/ddf6190))
- **playback,library:** strip HLS subtitle manifests for FFmpeg remux and populate all native Jellyfin library tabs ([c8cb151](https://github.com/FaserF/youtube-jellyfin/commit/c8cb151))

### ♻️ Code Improvements
